$comment: Pinned MXC native runtime. This is a release trust-chain input: the
archive integrity, the per-file SHA-256 values, and the PE machine type
are all verified before any file is staged into the package.
The official CLI owns the IsolationSession lifecycle and console relay.
PLM and other backend helpers are not part of this session runtime.
'wireSchemaVersion' pins the stable executor configuration schema.
Lifecycle operations and opaque container IDs use CLI arguments.
The archive release and configuration schema are separate trust inputs.
